usedFor: WooCommerce sees the buyer first; HubSpot is where you follow up. A “New Order Created” in the store can run “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot, so every customer has a record the sales side can use.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in WooCommerce, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It matches on email, so a returning buyer updates their record instead of creating a duplicate, which “Create Contact” alone would not guarantee.

watchOut: “Create Contact” in HubSpot needs an email, and a repeat buyer through that action is a second attempt on the same address. Use “Create or Update Contact” when customers order more than once.
